notes: Re-ran unprotected R&D several times per turn seeing the same top card, paid 2 credits per Liza tag repeatedly until broke, then sat clicking credits with no breakers while the corp advanced and scored out of Server 1.

Won with good early R&D aggression, but repeatedly ran Komainu with a full grip against PE (losing Sure Gamble, Siphon etc.), flirted with flatline, and set Security Testing on Archives every turn without ever running it.

Spammed 3-4 R&D runs per turn on the same top card while ignoring five naked remotes and Commercial Bankers, then sat at 0 credits with 3 tags against a tag-punish corp and was flatlined by High-Profile Target.

Reasonable HQ pressure and a good remote steal, but kept running HQ/R&D (including through Ansel) while the corp installed and advanced in Server 1 twice for the winning points, even clicking for credits on the turn an agenda sat there.
Won a long grind via R&D, but early turns were passive credit clicking at 9-13 credits while Obokata was advanced, and a lot of clicks and credits went into removing self-inflicted Liza tags.
After one successful steal, clicked for credits for five straight turns while banking 16-24 credits and watching the corp advance and score three agendas in a remote it had already broken into.
Won, but with odd choices: repeatedly spending clicks on Spy Camera stack peeks, an early Levy AR Lab Access, and eating three core damage from unbroken Fairchild ice instead of finding a breaker.

Sat at 0 credits for over ten turns running unprotected R&D/HQ four times a turn (often the same card), never clicking for credits, never trashing the corp's growing economy assets, and never checking the advanced remotes that scored the game.
From turn 3 on, clicked for credits every click up to 47 credits without installing a card or running once while the corp scored four agendas from a single remote.
Won via steady R&D pressure, but Zer0 self-damage trashed its own breakers, the stack ran out by turn 10, and it rarely contested the scoring remote.

Coherent, aggressive game that checked every new remote and stole five agendas; minor issues were losing DreamNet and taking core damage to an unrezzed Fairchild and an under-strength MKUltra against Ansel.
Won via persistent R&D runs, but ended a turn holding 4 tags with spare credits against a Hard-Hitting News corp (High-Profile Target was in HQ) and spent much of the game nearly broke.
Ran open HQ four times a turn re-seeing the same cards, then banked 20+ credits by clicking without ever installing a breaker, and finally ran into Ansel three times while declining to pay to steal.
Decent early remote trashing, then from turn 10 clicked for credits every click up to 50 credits without a single run while the corp advanced and scored three agendas in remotes.

Good start trashing economy assets, then economy dried up and it ran R&D once a turn on 0-3 credits while two Obokatas were scored unchallenged in a remote; it won only by stealing the last Obokata from R&D.
Built up 58 credits by clicking for credits every turn, never installing a breaker beyond MKUltra, while the corp scored four agendas out of Server 2 almost unopposed.

Won with sensible remote and R&D steals, but repeatedly ran HQ into the known unbroken Mausolus, taking damage and tags it never cleared, and wasted a run on Server 1 with no credits to pay Gagarin's access cost.

Declined to steal Fetal AI with 17 credits, ran into Enigma with no decoder six times, clicked for credits for turns while the corp scored, and then emptied its own grip on Komainu against a net-damage corp and was flatlined.
Steady R&D pressure won against a passive corp, but it was slow and wasted credits, for example paying to reinstall Paperclip twice in one encounter.
After one remote steal, clicked for credits for eight straight turns up to 36 credits without running, letting the corp install, advance and score twice to win.
